title: Super cute Snowman X Fresh Animations
description: Make your Minecraft world cuter with new snow golems, pumpkins, hats, scarves and rare variants.
body:
![Snowman_1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9c0ee07b81fc87b43ebf383e3bcc3a5f8e60bd44.png) # Super Cute Snowman ### About the Pack > **Super Cute Snowman** is a cute resource pack that improves the model and texture of snow golems, adds new variants, upgrades pumpkins, and lets you wear your own fancy little hat by renaming a carved pumpkin to **Hat**. > This pack was made with love to make your Minecraft world a little cuter ❤ --- ![EFR](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d41303bb3fd8ae26b0f5328b36e0543cfe5d8a4f.png)

                  

---

---
Feature List ## Snow Golem - New cute snow golem model and texture - Custom eye animations - compatible with Fresh Animations - New snow golem variants ## Variants - Normal Snowman - Scarf Snowman - Hat Smowman - Rare variant with both scarf and hat ## Pumpkins - New model and texture for Pumpkin - New model and texture for Carved Pumpkin - New model and texture for Jack o’ Lantern ## Custom Hat Item - Rename a Carved Pumpkin to **Hat** to get a custom wearable hat. ## Additional Features - Custom Snowman Spawnegg
Help # If the resource pack does not work correctly, please try these steps first: --- ## 1. Make sure you have the required mods installed For this pack to work correctly, you need: * **[Entity Model Features (EMF)](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features)** * **[Entity Texture Features (ETF)](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures)** --- ## 2. Check the resource pack order This resource pack should be enabled together with [Fresh Animations](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations). Recommended order: ![Pack order](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/701e5525f3d42fd7a7afe0a627292c56170789fe.png) --- ## 3. The hat is not showing The hat works by renaming a carved pumpkin. Steps: 1. Take a **Carved Pumpkin** 2. Rename it in an anvil to **Hat** 3. Wear it or use it as needed If the hat does not show up, make sure the name is written exactly as: **Hat** --- ## 4. Contact If the problem still cannot be solved, you can contact me on Discord. **Discord:** `matly_.`
Issues ## Known Issues - While the pumpkin is equipped, the nose is slightly moved back to avoid clipping. After removing the pumpkin, the nose returns to its normal position, but it may take a short moment to update. ## Contact - If you find any bugs or issues, feel free to contact me on Discord: `matly_.`
License ## This resource pack is licensed as **All Rights Reserved**. ### You are allowed to: - download and use this resource pack for personal use - use it in screenshots and videos - include it in modpacks, but only with credit and a link to this Modrinth page ### You are not allowed to: - re-upload this resource pack - claim this resource pack as your own - sell this resource pack - use textures, models or other assets from this pack in your own projects without permission If you want to use parts of this pack in your own project, please ask me first on Discord: `matly_.` --- ## Credits and compatibility All custom models and textures in this resource pack were made by **[MrMelon](https://modrinth.com/user/MrMelon)**. This resource pack is an unofficial pack made to work with **[Fresh Animations](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations)**, **[Entity Model Features (EMF)](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features)** and **[Entity Texture Features [ETF]](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures)**. This pack uses Fresh Animations-style animation compatibility so the snow golem can use animations with Fresh Animations. **Fresh Animations** belongs to **[FreshLX](https://modrinth.com/user/FreshLX)** and is not included as a full resource pack. Please download Fresh Animations separately from its official Modrinth page!
